title: Dibrugarh
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Dibrugarh, in Upper Assam on the south bank of the Brahmaputra, is a major tea, oil and education centre, often called the tea city of India.

Tea and oil

Dibrugarh district has many large tea gardens, and the town is a hub for tea trading and research. Nearby Digboi has one of Asia's oldest oil refineries, and Duliajan is home to Oil India Limited.

Education and transport

Dibrugarh University, Assam Medical College and several engineering and law colleges are based here. Mohanbari Airport connects the town by air, and the Bogibeel Bridge links it by road and rail to Dhemaji across the Brahmaputra.

Places

Visitors come for tea garden tours, the Brahmaputra riverfront, Jokai Botanical Garden and the nearby Dibru-Saikhowa National Park.
